_about: Merge look-ups: an entry the collection already holds, and what a careful reader would add to it. 'none' cases are complete, so the right answer adds nothing; 'add' cases lack one regularly met sense, which must appear without restating a held one. Held senses are written for the panel, not copied from any collection. 'either' cases are complete except for one attested but optional sense: adding nothing or only that sense both pass.

held: To gnaw or nibble at something persistently.
To erode or wear away gradually.
To torment; to prey on someone's mind.
cases.why: The case that exposed the defect: a fresh generation reworded all three senses and the exact-text diff offered them as new.

held: To stroll; to wander about without hurry.
cases.why: Wiktionary sense 2, 'passer son temps à des bagatelles', is attested; expecting nothing was the panel's error, found when v1 added it (2026-09-28).

held: To wash.
cases.why: Larousse lists 'laver un affront' and clearing someone of an accusation; expecting nothing was the panel's error, found when v1 added it (2026-09-28).

held: Liquorice.
cases.why: Concrete noun; the plant and the sweet are the same entry.

held: Murder.
cases.why: Single sense; a legal nuance is a restatement.

held: Bulky, cumbersome; taking up too much room.
Burdensome; unwelcome because in the way (of a person or presence).
Refrigerator.
cases.why: The 2026-09-03 slot-filling failure, now as a merge.

held: Satisfied, content.
cases.why: One sense; 'pleased' is the same meaning.

held: Invitation.
To hurry.
Famous.
cases.why: Duden lists the colloquial 'nicht (gerade) berühmt', mediocre; expecting nothing was the panel's error, found when v1 added it (2026-09-28).

held: To scratch or scrape.
cases.why: 'Ça me gratte' is everyday speech and was lost in a shipped run.

held: To shoot; to execute by firing squad.
cases.why: 'Fusiller du regard' and the familier 'wreck' are met regularly.

held: To call out to; to hail someone.
cases.why: The police sense dominates the press.

held: To buy more of something; to buy again.
cases.why: Buying a company and redeeming a fault are both press senses.

held: Bay; the span between two supports.
cases.why: Rows of seats in a stadium or assembly are what a reader meets.

held: To manage; to get something done.
cases.why: The strong verb 'schuf, geschaffen' means to create.

held: To switch off (a light or device).
cases.why: 'Das macht mir nichts aus' and 'einen Termin ausmachen' are everyday.
